test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the correct full form of NABARD from below?

options.text: National Bank for Agriculture and Resource Development
National Bank for Asian Research Development
National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
National Bank for Agriculture Related Development

solution:
The correct answer is **__National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NABARD**, as a Development Bank, is mandated for providing andregulating credit and other facilities for the promotion and development of agriculture.
 
• **NABARD** was established 12 July 1982 on the recommendations of B. Sivaraman Committee (by Act 61, 1981 of Parliament).
 
• **NABARD **is entrusted with the responsibility for conduct of statutory inspections of State Cooperative Banks, District Central Cooperative Banks and Regional Rural Banks under the **Banking Regulation Act, 1949.**
 
• The regulatory powers continue to be vested with the** Reserve Bank of India.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** NABARD includes:**__

 
 
• Regional Rural Banks (RRBs)
 
• State Cooperative Banks (StCBs)
 
• District Central Cooperative Banks (DCCBs)
 
• Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS)
 
• State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDBs)
 
• Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDBs)
